# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

Essay:
Think about the benefits of working with a group or working alone. Which do you feel is more beneficial? I think that working alone is better than work with a group because nobody can get mad if someone else does not work, you can do your work in your own way, and you will have your own opinion about what you are doing.

Firstly, nobody can get mad if someone else does not work. When people are working with a group, there are some people who does not work at all. If there is someone that does not work in the group, all the members of the group will get mad. For example, in math class the teacher use to tell us that we can work in groups, but I have some friend that the only thing that they do during I work is talk. When I finish with all the work, they ask me for the answers. When that happen I get mad, and that is the same situation that any group will have.

Secondly, you can do your work in your own way. If you work with a group, there are going to be more than one person. Not everyone likes to work in the same way that you do. In a group, people start doing things in their own way, and that is not going to work because all the work that the group make should look the same. Even when people are working in a presentation, they do their work different one to each other. For example, last semester the biology teacher gave the student the final exam, and she said that we can do it in partners. My friend and I decided that we can work together, but the next day he did not come to school. I started doing the final exam in my own way, and the next day he started helping me. The only things is that his work was completely different from mine, and the exam was not a success.

Finally, you will have your own opinion about what you are doing. Everyone have different point if view, and sometimes that make the work in group not a good decision. People will be telling you that you should do your work different or that what you are doing is not correct. When people start telling you that you are doing something wrong, you start thinking and feeling that you do not know how to do it or that you are wrong. To avoid this situation, is preferable to work alone and not with a group.

In conclusion, work with a group is not the best decision you can take. It is better if you work alone because nobody can get mad if someone else does not work, you can do your work in your own way, and you will have your own opinion about what you are doing. You are going to feel better if you do your work by yourself. Whenever you have any question, you can ask your teacher to make sure you are doing your work right.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

### Target Essay

Imagine the president and the government of our country being nothing but idle and letting the country run on its own. There would be no regulation in the country. The history would repeat itself and many of the tragic historical events that happened in the past would happen again. We talk about the American Dream a lot but being lazy and just waiting for something to happen will not take us anywhere.

As Thomas Jefferson said, "Determine never to be idle...It is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing", I agree that if we always do something we accomplish more.

We as human beings have so much potentials in us but we will never discover it through inactive.

Firstly, I believe that inventions and new discoveries have made people more lazy and inactive. I dont blame Inventions and discoveries because they were made with good intentions and not through idle ism but there are people who trust inventions more then they have to. There is always something to do in this world; we accomplish more when we aim higher. Even small chores prepare us for something big. laziness is a big wooden door which can only open by ourselves and once we open that door, theres always something big waiting to happen and once we accomplish that another big adventure awaits.

In the history of United States, there were many people who idolized idle. We had a government who let the country run free, this had a great impact to the country. the country was poor, people died because of huger, disease etc but now the country has accomplished so much then the people in our past would have imagined. The country is well know all over the world now. The country has accomplished by establishing government regulation which removed all the laziness from the country. If a whole country can accomplish so much from not being lazy then imagine what a person can accomplish.

I believe there are people who supports on being idle more that have to do work. I agree that it is okay to not do anytime sometimes because everyone needs a break in their lives. There are people who believe in not having to go outside their house because they have all the technologies or they think they have nothing to do. Technologies serve their own purpose but we have our own purpose, we are born to do something big. If we could just go out and just help one person and day, that person would help another and another to another, this would be such a great accomplishment.

In conclusion, I agree on what Thomas Jefferson said and believe that there is more happiness in doing something everyday then being a idle. I hope everyone see's how much bad impact idle is in our lives.

Imagine the president and the government of our country being nothing but idle and letting the country run on its own. There would be no regulation in the country. The history would repeat itself and many of the tragic historical events that happened in the past would happen again. We talk about the American Dream a lot but being lazy and just waiting for something to happen will not take us anywhere.

As Thomas Jefferson said, "Determine never to be idle...It is wonderful how much may be done if we are always doing", I agree that if we always do something we accomplish more.

We as human beings have so much potentials in us but we will never discover it through inactive.

Firstly, I believe that inventions and new discoveries have made people more lazy and inactive. I dont blame Inventions and discoveries because they were made with good intentions and not through idle ism but there are people who trust inventions more then they have to. There is always something to do in this world; we accomplish more when we aim higher. Even small chores prepare us for something big. laziness is a big wooden door which can only open by ourselves and once we open that door, theres always something big waiting to happen and once we accomplish that another big adventure awaits.

In the history of United States, there were many people who idolized idle. We had a government who let the country run free, this had a great impact to the country. the country was poor, people died because of huger, disease etc but now the country has accomplished so much then the people in our past would have imagined. The country is well know all over the world now. The country has accomplished by establishing government regulation which removed all the laziness from the country. If a whole country can accomplish so much from not being lazy then imagine what a person can accomplish.

I believe there are people who supports on being idle more that have to do work. I agree that it is okay to not do anytime sometimes because everyone needs a break in their lives. There are people who believe in not having to go outside their house because they have all the technologies or they think they have nothing to do. Technologies serve their own purpose but we have our own purpose, we are born to do something big. If we could just go out and just help one person and day, that person would help another and another to another, this would be such a great accomplishment.

In conclusion, I agree on what Thomas Jefferson said and believe that there is more happiness in doing something everyday then being a idle. I hope everyone see's how much bad impact idle is in our lives.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

## Score 3

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

Essay:
Did you know that some teachers/educators want year round of school. My decision for this topic would be, I want year round of school. I feel it would benefit students and teachers to actually focus and maintain on school work. Some students would disagree with this, but there are some supportive reasons why this would benefit the both.

Reasoning number one, Most students take a 3 to 4 month summer break. If there was year round schools it would 3 to 4 week summer break, a longer winter break, and one week off for winter and fall time. This would benefit students to be able to retain lots of amounts of information. Also students would have an extra break for the one week off in the fall time.

Reasoning number two, Students who take more than a 2 month break will most likely forget what they have been taught in school. That adds more work to teachers because they would have to re teach the information back to the students, and it would take longer for the students to remember the information. Students who would do year round of school would be able to remember the information that they were taught and it would be less work for teachers for them to re teach it.

Last reasoning, After when students come back for a break most teachers have to re teach what they taught the students before break. Also normally when students come back from long breaks some teachers start giving tests or even quizzes. Most students don't study while they are on break, so they are likely not able to recieve a good grade on the test and quizzes. But with year round school the students would be able to obtain the information and less likely fto orgot what they have been taught before Summer, Spring or Winter break.

Overall, It just seems students and teachers would benefit a lot more with school being year round. The teachers would have less to re teach and students can obtain more information. Also it would help studnets do better when it comes to taking to tests or quizzes. So it would be a win win for everybody.

I think that we should have after school homework clubs in school because it can really help kids get homework done at the right time so they don't get a zero on their homework.

There is kids that get too much homework so homework club would be a good time for them to get their work done so fast that they don't need to worry about it when they get home. Some kids might struggle in one class because they have a lot of assignments that they need to make up. Homework club will give students plenty of time to get

missing

work done, and they should move the grade up to an A or B. You could also get homework from a bunch of different classes, and homework club will give them enough time to get the easy assignments done, so that they can focus on getting a hard assignment done, and that would leave the students with one assignment left to do.

Homework club can be seen as a way to spend your time wisely when it comes to getting homework done. It reduces the stress of getting too much homework because students will realize how much time that they have to get their

work done so they can focus on the activities that they do in or outside of school.

For example, someone might have soccer practice at 5:30, and homework club might be from 2:30 to 4:50. That would give a student enough time to get a lot of work done before soccer practice. It's better to finish homework early because you would not need to worry about it for the rest of the week.

Sometimes kids need assistance from teachers because they are struggling to understand the subject, and they may need a teacher's help. The could stay at homework club so students can work

with the teacher to get the work done. A student might leave an assignment at the last minute because they had other assignments to do. If homework club will give a student two hours in a half to do their assignment, they should be able to get their work done just in time. Homework club can give relief to a student when they have left an assignment at the last minute.

I believe that if a lot of kids went to homework club, then all students will be successful.

That would mean that kids will get As and Bs from now on, and they would not need to stress about their grades. It just takes students to use their time wisely at homework club to get homework done,

and no one will have any problems.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

### Target Essay

Have you ever tried your best at achieving something but failed in the end?

some may say that success relies on how much one progresses, but others may say it's not how much one achieves, but how well you do it. No matter if

you fail at something, you can always look at the situation in a better light. For instance, you see a job that interests you, you do your best to prepare for the interview. You take your clothes to the dry cleaners, get a good nights rest, and have good manners while in the interview. You are certain the job is yours. But the company decides not to hire you. Many would

say that you have failed, but if you look at the situation with a better attitude, one can see your strong points and weaknesses.

Life is all about bettering yourself. No matter how many times people say you have failed, if you have a positive attitude you will have never truly failed. One can always see places they need to improve within themselves. Keeping a good attitude will always make you more successful.

# ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

Naruto, a shinobi who dreamed of becoming the hokage, always had self-confidence when he was little. A teacher named Mizuki told naruto to take this secret scroll, which contained forbidden jutsu that he can practice. He trained until he was caught by Iruka sensei, they both were being attacked by mizuki and told naruto that there was a decree. Naruto

felt depressed and fought mizuki and showed his multi shadow clone jutsu and received a leaf head-band. After all of that sadness and sorrow he met his rival Sasuke, he's another shinobi, his goal was to get revenge on his brother for slaughtering the whole uchiha clan. Naruto became jealous of Sasuke and started to train everyday, until sasuke finally noticed that naruto is catching up very fast. Sasuke spars with naruto and tried to kill him because how he's becoming weaker, sasuke realizes that he needs more power. Sasuke decides to leave the village and seek power, but naruto tries to bring him back but fails. In the end, naruto becomes the hokage and sasuke returns to the village in the future. This example explains that having self-confidence can get you through many things such as rivalries, challenges, and overcoming failures.

Furthermore, self-esteem comes from praise because it can help you feel comfortable in taking on a challenge. Students know when there is an upcoming test or exam, and they are just to afraid to mess it up and fail. Students study and try to memorize what they have to do to properly figure out how to get the right answer, but when they encounter a question they struggled the most, they are scared and are stressed. Take this for an example, a test is announced two weeks later, and it's 10 percent for their grade. One student get stuck on a question and is very stressed, and is trying to memorize what to do to figure out this question. He remembered that every time you drag the number to the other side, you switch the sign. This example proves how self-confidence affects peoples struggles and how they can relieve of there stress.

However, many disagree with the whole self-esteem and self-confidence thing because people will think that praising for deficient work undermines learning by lowering standards, and that the true source of self-esstem is achievement. Achievement and self-confidence help people understand that without confidence there is no possibility in achieving anything.

In conclusion, self-esteem comes from praise because people will need self-confidence to achieve their goal and it can help you feel comfortable on taking a challenge.

### Target Essay

People who value self-reliance define it as the need for each individual to follow his or her own instincts and ideas. There is a quote that says, "If you want to go fast go by yourself, but if you want to far go with someone else". As the quote says, I think that it's very important to have someone to guide us throughout the course of our lives. I agree that seeking for guidance from experts to make wise decisions can have a great impact in our lives. Experts and authorities can provide us with advices to make good decisions in life and accomplish our goals more easily.

First of all, having someone to guide you throughout the decisions you make in life could help you accomplish a goal a lot easier. For example, when I was in middle school I used to think that doing individual work was faster and easier. However, I noticed that most of my classmates who worked in groups finished all the assignments in less time than I did. This experience showed me the importance of always having someone to give you their opinion to accomplish a goal quickly and avoid wasting your time. Thus, seeking for guidance from experts can help you achieve any goal you set in life and avoid wastig your time on making wrong decisions.

In addition, you will learn and gain experience if you have someone expert to guide you. For example, having an expert guiding you will allow you to see his different points of view and learned from his teachings. This will allow you to learn from his teachings and experiences and reflect about them. # ELLIPSE Overall Scoring Rubric

> Extracted verbatim from the Overall (HOLISTIC) column of the source rubric; whitespace only normalized.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

Essay:
To commit to a specific career at a young age is a good idea, and I am here to tell you why. Did you ever stress out about what you wanted to be after high school? Could that have affected you because you were not thinking about it growing up? That is possible because I believe that if things are planned out,it is easier to know what to do when it comes time to it. Committing to a career at a young age gives you time to prepare yourself for that specific career. You can take your time to practice what you need to know about the career you are picking.

When you want to prepare for something, it is true that you need to practice. Practice can take you a long way to end up achieving perfection. If you can think of what you want to be at a young age, you can achieve perfection when it is time to work. Surely every type of job needs some sort of practice, so there is always a need to practice and master it. Early knowledge from practicing can do a lot for you when it comes time.

Before you practice, you are going to need knowledge of what you need to know about that specific career. Studying what you need to know about your future career, can also be a big help to figure out what you need to do. You can study and then practice things you find difficult about that career, it will possibly be a big help on specific section of the job you plan on working on. Studying about the job is really important because if you have no clue what your doing, your career can be easily ruined.

It needs practice because you can not expect to master something without any practice. You will also need to study about what needs to be done about the career you choose,because you will need to know what is needed to be worked on. In conclusion, committing to a career at a young age is a good idea because it gives you a head start on what needs to be done.

## Score 5

Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

## Score 4

Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.

## Score 3

Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.

## Score 2

Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.

## Score 1

A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.

### Target Essay

Setting good examples by people's good behavior marks the sign as an excellent impression amongst other people out there. People's mesmerizing personality traits are expressed in many ways that every other person would wish to have. Although there may be better ways to influence people, setting good examples by good behavior is the alternative approach since people are more ambitious towards achieving their own personal goals without getting influenced through another crowd of people or becoming a better person in general.

Students at school are overcoming their own mental challenges through self- esteem. One shy girl who dresses awkwardley, contains acne on her face, and the "nerd" of her entire school focuses on her assignments being given to her without any distractions. She is very negligent about the unpleasant comments other people in the school say about her. Role models in school strive to be superior amongst all students to show that over achievers are excelling with their education. An attractive guy who plays football and stays consistent with his schoolwork is disciplined and would never get caught up with all of the petty and ignorant others. Some athletes or even "attractive athletes" want to pursue their own personal goals to get where they want to be.

Employees and their bosses put their time and effort towards making decent amount of money to provide for their families. In the field of dentistry, Dentists constantly work hard to ensure that their own patients are receiving outstanding treatments and informing them about how important it is to brush and floss their teeth twice a day. Patients admire graceful dentists who care and knows what is best for people when it comes to any conflicted situation. Waiters or waitresses who work at restaurants attempt to impress people who are dining and meet customer's needs. Their goal is to help the business succeed because they want customers to have a joyous experience.

Yes people can advocate for others who have different standards than their own and have them transform into being the person they were destined to become or focusing what matters more in life. However, finding solutions towards the opposite path can help build a stronger motive. A swimmer who was caught up with all of the petty drama her friends started, decided not to be part of it anymore when all of her swim races were horrendous. Instead, she wanted to worry about herself and her own progress by not only becoming good at what she does, but also a better role model. A student who fails a test will feel like their life is distraught and depressing after working hard at what they did, but finds a solution to thrive and not struggle anymore. Not giving up entirely is the key to achieving the grade they want and having better outcomes.

Whether it is striving to become a better person or achieving what everybody wants without any distractions, those are some good examples that people set out for the world to see. Good examples are intended to help people with lower standards or self-esteem and realize that the people who are succeeding, never took part in anything bizarre and distracting that could potentially harm their personalized ambitions in the first place. They show how being a good person with outstanding morals are determined to thrive.

Not giving up entirely is the key to achieving the grade they want and having better outcomes.

### Rec-SAVER参照の照合

既存verified_reference_poolとのtarget重複は 2 件、そのうちhistory IDsが順序も含め一致するtargetは 2 件。
参照の生成元はoutputs/overall_rubric_ablationであり、対象と履歴の一致だけで全面再利用可能とは断定できない。Rubric/本文/参照生成条件のhash照合を追加して採否を判断する。
既存評価値の転記は行っていない。新規比較時はreasoningの3要素のみ文章化し、tendencyを含むJSON全体は比較しない。
追加所要時間は未実測。新規参照が必要な対象数と検証retry数を確定し、小規模実測後に見積もる。
